english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a completed work of art, literature, or music.
Use this for a concrete work, invention, or other thing that someone has made.
Choose this for a finished work viewed as something created by an author, rather than simply as text.
Use 作品 for a literary, artistic, or intellectual work as a finished creation.

examples.traditional: 呢件作品真係好有感染力。
